عُلَاوَةٌ : see عُلْوٌ. ―
-b2- عُلَاوَةُ الرِّيحِ means The windward side; the side, or quarter, from which the wind blows; with respect to the game, or object of the chase; (S, TA;) and with respect to a man: (TA:) opposed to سُفَالَتُهَا. (S, Msb, * TA.) [See 1, last quarter.]
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
